item.description: ### Changed - **Per-model usage bars are on for everyone, and the switch is gone.** They used to be behind a "Show per-model limits" setting that was off unless you found it. It also did more than its name suggested: it's what keeps the 5-hour and weekly numbers coming from Claude and Codex themselves, rather than from whatever was last written on this Mac — which goes stale as soon as your sessions go quiet. - **Model bars now show even at 0%.** Previously a model you hadn't used yet was hidden, which meant most people saw no bars at all and had no way to tell the feature was working. A model with its own weekly cap now always gets a row. - **Cursor gets a second usage bar too.** Cursor meters your billing period twice — once against your plan's total allowance and once against its API allowance — and those two really do differ. The headline bar is unchanged; the API figure now appears beneath it, the same way Claude's per-model bars sit under its weekly one. - The Usage section of Settings has no switches left. It now just explains where the numbers come from: Perch asks each service directly, using the login that agent already saved on this Mac, read-only, and only while you have a session open with that agent.
